   599	  it('RED (G2): iterationCap 6 in loop.json is REJECTED (exit 2) BEFORE any spawn (the 5-cap is a hard invariant)', async () => {
   600	    const io = makePipeRepo({ spec: pipelineSpec({ budgets: { iterationCap: 6, perRoleTimeoutMin: 30, maxChildrenPerPhase: 10 } }) });
   601	    const code = await run(['pipeline', 'run'], io);
   602	    assert.equal(code, 2, 'a spec asking for a 6th iteration is invalid');
   603	    assert.match(io.stderrText() + io.stdoutText(), /iterationCap|cap/i, 'the error names the cap');
   604	    assert.equal(io.__runner.calls.length, 0, 'no child spawns for an invalid spec');
   605	  });
   606	
   607	  it('RED (G2): a LIVE supervisor.lock refuses pipeline run (exit 1), zero spawns', async () => {
   608	    const io = makePipeRepo();
   609	    io.processAlive = (p) => p === 55555;
   610	    const p = loopPaths('/repo');
   611	    io.fs.mkdirSync(p.dir, { recursive: true });
   612	    io.fs.writeFileSync(`${p.dir}/supervisor.lock`, JSON.stringify({ host: 'pipe-host', pid: 55555, startTime: 222, runId: 'other' }));
   613	    const code = await run(['pipeline', 'run'], io);
   614	    assert.equal(code, 1, 'a live supervisor blocks a concurrent pipeline run');
   615	    assert.match(io.stderrText() + io.stdoutText(), /55555|lock|supervisor/i, 'the refusal names the live supervisor');
   616	    assert.equal(io.__runner.calls.length, 0, 'no child spawned while another supervisor is live');
   617	  });

   619	  it('RED (G2): a stale pre-existing subtask branch PARKS (exit 4) instead of crashing', async () => {
   620	    const git = pipelineGit({ existingBranches: ['baton/wt-a/subtask-t1'] });
   621	    const io = makePipeRepo({ git, runner: undefined });
   622	    io.superviseChild = fakeRunner(io, [...cleanSubtask(), ...cleanSubtask()]);
   623	    io.__runner = io.superviseChild;
   624	    let code;
   625	    await assert.doesNotReject(async () => { code = await run(['pipeline', 'run'], io); }, 'a stale branch must not crash the supervisor');
   626	    assert.equal(code, 4, 'a stale subtask branch parks the run');
   627	    assert.equal((await loadLoopState('/repo', io)).state.status, LOOP_STATUS.PARKED);
   628	  });
   629	
   630	  it('RED (G2): a second pipeline run RESUMES loadLoopState — cap counters survive re-invocation (no refund)', async () => {
   631	    // A strict runner that NEVER falls back to default-APPROVED: it throws once
   632	    // the script is exhausted, so a re-initing (refunding) impl is caught rather
   633	    // than masked. The checkout -b branch state is neutralized by giving each run
   634	    // a fresh git (a resumed run legitimately reuses persisted worktree state).
   635	    const strictRunner = (io, script) => {
   636	      const queue = [...script];
   637	      const calls = [];
   638	      const fn = (spec, opts) => {
   639	        if (queue.length === 0) throw new Error('strictRunner: queue exhausted (no default-APPROVED fallback)');
   640	        calls.push({ spec, opts, command: spec?.command, args: spec?.args ?? [] });
   641	        const r = queue.shift();
   642	        return Promise.resolve({ timedOut: false, exitCode: 0, verdict: r.verdict, findings: r.findings ?? '', logPath: opts.logPath });
   643	      };
   644	      fn.calls = calls;
   645	      return fn;
   646	    };
   647	    const freshGit = () => { const g = pipelineGit(); g.setLockProbe(() => io.fs.existsSync(MERGE_LOCK)); return g; };
   648	
   649	    const spec = pipelineSpec({ subtasks: [{ id: 't1', title: 'only' }] });
   650	    const io = makePipeRepo({ spec, runner: undefined });
   651	
   652	    // Run 1 crashes at EXACTLY 3 persisted review iterations: writer+reviewer(BLOCKED)
   653	    // x3, then the 4th writer spawn throws (a supervisor crash mid-run).
   654	    io.execFile = freshGit();
   655	    const runner1 = strictRunner(io, [
   656	      { verdict: 'APPROVED' }, { verdict: 'BLOCKED', findings: 'x' },
   657	      { verdict: 'APPROVED' }, { verdict: 'BLOCKED', findings: 'x' },
   658	      { verdict: 'APPROVED' }, { verdict: 'BLOCKED', findings: 'x' },
   659	    ]);
   660	    io.superviseChild = runner1;
   661	    io.__runner = runner1;
   662	    let firstCode = 'ran';
   663	    try { firstCode = await run(['pipeline', 'run'], io); } catch { firstCode = 'crashed'; }
   664	    assert.equal((await loadLoopState('/repo', io)).state.iterations['subtask-t1-review'], 3, 'exactly 3 review iterations persisted before the crash');
   665	
   666	    // Run 2 resumes: two more BLOCKED reviews reach the 5-cap; the 6th escalates.
   667	    // The strict runner throws on a 5th call, so a REFUNDING (re-init) impl — which
   668	    // would need more attempts before escalating — fails to reach exit 3.
   669	    io.execFile = freshGit();
   670	    const runner2 = strictRunner(io, [
   671	      { verdict: 'APPROVED' }, { verdict: 'BLOCKED', findings: 'x' }, // iteration 4
   672	      { verdict: 'APPROVED' }, { verdict: 'BLOCKED', findings: 'x' }, // iteration 5 -> next spawn is refused by the cap
   673	    ]);
   674	    io.superviseChild = runner2;
   675	    io.__runner = runner2;
   676	    let second = 'ran';
   677	    try { second = await run(['pipeline', 'run'], io); } catch { second = 'crashed'; }
   678	    assert.equal(second, 3, 'the cap counter survived re-invocation — cumulative attempts (3+2) escalate, not refund');
   679	    assert.equal((await loadLoopState('/repo', io)).state.status, LOOP_STATUS.ESCALATED);
   680	  });
   681	});

   685	describe('pipeline — G3: writer result handling', () => {
   686	  it('RED (G3): a writer BLOCKED retries the WRITER without spawning a reviewer for the failed attempt', async () => {
   687	    const io = makePipeRepo({ spec: pipelineSpec({ subtasks: [{ id: 't1', title: 'only' }] }), runner: undefined });

   689	      { verdict: 'BLOCKED', findings: 'writer-not-done' }, // writer 1 fails its own self-check
   690	      { verdict: 'APPROVED' }, // writer retry
   691	      { verdict: 'APPROVED' }, // reviewer
   692	      { verdict: 'APPROVED' }, // merger
   693	    ]);
   694	    io.__runner = io.superviseChild;
   695	    await run(['pipeline', 'run'], io);
   696	    // Two write-capable writer attempts ran; no reviewer ran until the writer passed.
   697	    assert.equal(writersOf(io.__runner).length, 2, 'the BLOCKED writer retried');
   698	    // The FIRST reviewer spawn must come AFTER the second (passing) writer — never
   699	    // a review of the first, failed writer attempt.

   701	    const writerIdxs = io.__runner.calls.map((c, i) => (valAfter(argsOf(c), '-s') === 'workspace-write' ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0);
   702	    assert.ok(firstReviewerIdx > writerIdxs[1], 'no reviewer spawned for the failed writer attempt (review only follows a passing writer)');
   703	  });

   391	describe('pipeline — verdict flow', () => {
   392	  it('reviewer APPROVED -> the MERGER child runs (merger model); on its APPROVED the SUPERVISOR merges via mergeSubtask', async () => {
   393	    const io = makePipeRepo({ runner: undefined });

   398	    // The merger child ran on the merger chain model and is NON-git-capable

   412	    }

    61	const VERDICT_RE = /VERDICT:\s*(APPROVED_WITH_NOTES|APPROVED|BLOCKED)\b/g;
    62	
    63	/** @param {string} region @returns {{verdict: string, findings: string} | null} */
    64	function lastVerdictIn(region) {
    65	  let last = null;
    66	  for (const m of region.matchAll(VERDICT_RE)) last = m;
    67	  if (!last) return null;
    68	  const after = region.slice((last.index ?? 0) + last[0].length);
    69	  return { verdict: last[1], findings: after.trim() };
    70	}
    71	
    72	/**
    73	 * Region-bounded verdict parsing — the prompt region (which quotes the
    74	 * verdict format in its instructions) is NEVER scanned, and there is no
    75	 * whole-transcript fallback. Unparseable is BLOCKED, never APPROVED.
    76	 * - codex: only the text after the LAST line starting with 'tokens used'.
    77	 * - claude-code: only the `result` field of the structured JSON output.
    78	 * Multiple tails inside the trusted region → the LAST one wins.
    79	 * @param {string} transcript @param {{platform: string}} opts
    80	 * @returns {{verdict: string, findings: string, reason?: string}}
    81	 */
    82	export function parseVerdict(transcript, { platform }) {
    83	  const unparseable = { verdict: 'BLOCKED', findings: '', reason: 'unparseable' };
    84	  const text = String(transcript ?? '');
    85	
    86	  if (platform === 'claude-code') {
    87	    let obj = null;
    88	    try {
    89	      obj = JSON.parse(text.trim());
    90	    } catch {
    91	      return unparseable;
    92	    }
    93	    if (typeof obj?.result !== 'string') return unparseable;
    94	    const hit = lastVerdictIn(obj.result);
    95	    return hit ?? unparseable;
    96	  }
    97	
    98	  // codex: locate the LAST 'tokens used' marker line; the trusted region is
    99	  // strictly after it.
   100	  const lines = text.split('\n');
   101	  let markerLine = -1;
   102	  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i += 1) {
   103	    if (/^tokens used\b/i.test(lines[i])) markerLine = i;
   104	  }
   105	  if (markerLine === -1) return unparseable;
   106	  const region = lines.slice(markerLine + 1).join('\n');
   107	  const hit = lastVerdictIn(region);
   108	  return hit ?? unparseable;
   109	}

   111	const TRUNCATION_MARKER = '\n[... truncated by baton log cap ...]\n';
   112	
   113	/**
   114	 * Cap a transcript: head preserved, middle replaced with a marker, TAIL
   115	 * preserved verbatim (the verdict lives at the end and must never be cut).
   116	 * @param {string} text @param {number} maxBytes
   117	 * @returns {string}
   118	 */
   119	export function capLog(text, maxBytes) {
   120	  const s = String(text ?? '');
   121	  if (Buffer.byteLength(s) <= maxBytes) return s;
   122	  const headBytes = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxBytes * 0.4));
   123	  const tailBytes = Math.max(1, maxBytes - headBytes);
   124	  const buf = Buffer.from(s);
   125	  const head = buf.subarray(0, headBytes).toString();
   126	  const tail = buf.subarray(buf.length - tailBytes).toString();
   127	  return head + TRUNCATION_MARKER + tail;
   128	}

   132	 * signature table, no drift. Returns exactly classify(...).class.

   134	 * @returns {string}
   135	 */
   136	export function classifyChildExit(transcript, exitCode, platform, table) {
   137	  return classify({ text: transcript, exitCode, platform, table }).class;
   138	}

   140	/** @param {number} pid @param {NodeJS.Signals} sig */
   141	function killGroup(pid, sig) {
   142	  try {
   143	    process.kill(-pid, sig);
   144	  } catch {
   145	    // ESRCH — already gone.
   146	  }
   147	}
   148	
   149	/**
   150	 * Spawn and supervise one child: detached in its OWN process group, stdin
   151	 * closed; on timeout SIGTERM the group, wait graceMs, SIGKILL the group (no
   152	 * zombie grandchildren). Output streams to a capped log at opts.logPath; the
   153	 * verdict is parsed from the full transcript, region-bounded.
   154	 * @param {{command: string, args: string[], env?: Record<string, string>, cwd?: string}} spec
   155	 * @param {{timeoutMs: number, graceMs: number, logPath: string, maxLogBytes?: number, platform?: string}} opts
   156	 * @returns {Promise<{timedOut: boolean, exitCode: number | null, verdict?: string, findings?: string, reason?: string, logPath: string}>}
   157	 */
   158	export function superviseChild(spec, opts) {
   159	  return new Promise((resolve) => {
   160	    const maxLogBytes = opts.maxLogBytes ?? 1_000_000;
   161	    const child = spawn(spec.command, spec.args, {
   162	      cwd: spec.cwd,
   163	      env: { ...process.env, ...(spec.env ?? {}) },
   164	      stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
   165	      detached: true, // its own process group — the kill unit
   166	    });
   167	
   168	    let out = '';
   169	    let timedOut = false;
   170	    /** @type {NodeJS.Timeout | null} */
   171	    let killTimer = null;
   172	
   173	    const onChunk = (/** @type {Buffer} */ c) => {
   174	      out += c.toString();
   175	    };
   176	    child.stdout?.on('data', onChunk);
   177	    child.stderr?.on('data', onChunk);
   178	
   179	    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
   180	      timedOut = true;
   181	      if (typeof child.pid === 'number') {
   182	        killGroup(child.pid, 'SIGTERM');
   183	        killTimer = setTimeout(() => {
   184	          if (typeof child.pid === 'number') killGroup(child.pid, 'SIGKILL');
   185	        }, opts.graceMs);
   186	      }
   187	    }, opts.timeoutMs);
   188	
   189	    const finish = (/** @type {number | null} */ exitCode) => {
   190	      clearTimeout(timeout);
   191	      if (killTimer) clearTimeout(killTimer);
   192	      // Belt-and-braces: reap any group survivors even on a clean exit path.
   193	      if (timedOut && typeof child.pid === 'number') killGroup(child.pid, 'SIGKILL');
   194	      try {
   195	        mkdirSync(dirname(opts.logPath), { recursive: true });
   196	        writeFileSync(opts.logPath, capLog(out, maxLogBytes));
   197	      } catch {
   198	        // The log must never mask the result.
   199	      }
   200	      const parsed = parseVerdict(out, { platform: opts.platform ?? 'codex' });
   201	      resolve({
   202	        timedOut,
   203	        exitCode: timedOut ? null : exitCode,
   204	        verdict: parsed.verdict,
   205	        findings: parsed.findings,
   206	        ...(parsed.reason ? { reason: parsed.reason } : {}),
   207	        logPath: opts.logPath,
   208	      });
   209	    };
   210	
   211	    child.on('error', () => finish(null));
   212	    child.on('close', (code) => finish(code));
   213	  });
   214	}

    32	 * @param {string[]} args @param {any} io

    35	export async function cmdPipeline(args, io) {
    36	  /** @type {string[]} */
    37	  const positionals = [];
    38	  /** @type {string[]} */
    39	  const flagTokens = [];
    40	  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i += 1) {
    41	    const a = args[i];
    42	    if (typeof a === 'string' && a.startsWith('--')) {
    43	      flagTokens.push(a);
    44	      if (STRING_FLAGS.has(a.slice(2)) && i + 1 < args.length) {
    45	        i += 1;
    46	        flagTokens.push(args[i]);
    47	      }
    48	    } else {
    49	      positionals.push(a);
    50	    }
    51	  }
    52	  const parsed = parseFlagsStrict(flagTokens, {});
    53	  if (parsed.error !== undefined) return usageError(io, parsed.flags, 'pipeline', parsed.error);
    54	  const flags = parsed.flags;
    55	
    56	  const sub = positionals[0];
    57	  if (sub === undefined) return usageError(io, flags, 'pipeline', 'a subcommand is required — try: baton pipeline run');
    58	  if (sub !== 'run') return usageError(io, flags, 'pipeline', `unknown subcommand '${sub}' (supported: run)`);
    59	  if (positionals.length > 1) return usageError(io, flags, 'pipeline', `unexpected argument '${positionals[1]}'`);
    60

    64	/** Validate the spec's subtasks — every rejection names its offender.
    65	 * @param {any} subtasks @returns {string | null} */
    66	function validateSubtasks(subtasks) {
    67	  if (!Array.isArray(subtasks) || subtasks.length === 0) {
    68	    return 'loop.json needs a non-empty `subtasks` array ([{id, title}]) for a pipeline run';
    69	  }
    70	  const seen = new Set();
    71	  for (let i = 0; i < subtasks.length; i += 1) {
    72	    const st = subtasks[i];
    73	    if (typeof st?.id !== 'string' || st.id.length === 0) return `subtasks[${i}] is missing a string id`;
    74	    if (typeof st?.title !== 'string' || st.title.length === 0) return `subtasks[${i}] ('${st.id}') is missing a string title`;
    75	    if (seen.has(st.id)) return `subtasks carry a duplicate id '${st.id}' — ids name branches and must be unique`;
    76	    seen.add(st.id);
    77	  }
    78	  return null;
    79	}

+// B8 (G2) — the run-lock acquisition must be ATOMIC, not check-then-write.
+describe('loop run — atomic run-lock acquisition (B8)', () => {
+  const DIR = `${loopPaths('/repo').dir}`;
+  const LOCK = `${DIR}/supervisor.lock`;
+
+  it('RED (B8): implementation-neutral — an exclusive-create acquire refuses a competitor that appears in the gap; check-then-write clobbers (RED)', async () => {
+    const io = makeLoopRepo({ runner: undefined });
+    io.superviseChild = fakeRunner(io, [{ verdict: 'APPROVED' }, { verdict: 'APPROVED' }]);
+    io.__runner = io.superviseChild;
+    io.processAlive = (p) => p === 55555; // the competitor supervisor is LIVE
+
+    // Enforce the O_EXCL semantics memfs lacks so this pin PASSES for a correct
+    // exclusive acquire (writeFileSync flag 'wx'/'ax' OR mkdirSync — both throw
+    // EEXIST when the target exists) and FAILS for a clobbering check-then-write
+    // (a plain write / tmp+rename overwrites).
+    const realWrite = io.fs.writeFileSync.bind(io.fs);
+    io.fs.writeFileSync = (/** @type {any} */ p, /** @type {any} */ data, /** @type {any} */ opts) => {
+      const flag = typeof opts === 'string' ? undefined : opts?.flag;
+      if ((flag === 'wx' || flag === 'ax' || flag === 'wx+' || flag === 'ax+') && io.fs.existsSync(p)) {
+        throw Object.assign(new Error(`EEXIST: file already exists, open '${p}'`), { code: 'EEXIST' });
+      }
+      return realWrite(p, data, opts);
+    };
+
+    // Exploit the check→write gap at the acquire's READ of a missing lock: a live
+    // competitor acquires it before our write lands.
+    const realRead = io.fs.readFileSync.bind(io.fs);
+    let injected = false;
+    io.fs.readFileSync = (/** @type {any} */ p, /** @type {any} */ enc) => {
+      if (String(p) === LOCK && !injected) {
+        try {
+          return realRead(p, enc);
+        } catch (e) {
+          injected = true;
+          io.fs.mkdirSync(DIR, { recursive: true });
+          realWrite(LOCK, JSON.stringify({ host: 'loop-host', pid: 55555, startTime: 222, runId: 'competitor' }));
+          throw e;
+        }
+      }
+      return realRead(p, enc);
+    };
+
+    const code = await cmdLoop(['run'], io);
+    assert.equal(code, 1, 'an exclusive acquire refuses a lock that a live competitor took in the gap');
+    assert.equal(io.__runner.calls.length, 0, 'no child spawned when the lock was lost in the gap');
+    assert.match(JSON.parse(io.files()[LOCK]).runId, /competitor/, "the competitor's lock is not clobbered");
+  });

    14	/**
    15	 * Rename with retry on EPERM (Windows AV/indexer lock pattern): 3 attempts total.
    16	 * @param {any} fs @param {string} from @param {string} to
    17	 */
    18	function renameWithRetry(fs, from, to) {
    19	  let lastErr;
    20	  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt += 1) {
    21	    try {
    22	      fs.renameSync(from, to);
    23	      return;
    24	    } catch (err) {
    25	      lastErr = err;
    26	      if (!err || /** @type {any} */ (err).code !== 'EPERM') throw err;
    27	    }
    28	  }
    29	  throw lastErr;
    30	}

    37	export function atomicWriteText(fs, path, content) {
